seller_inbound: What are you offering? Give me an offer first.
final_approved_text: John does our underwriting based on what the house needs. What are you hoping to walk away with?
notes: Handles seller pushing for offer first by anchoring on John doing underwriting.

seller_inbound: I saw on Zillow it is worth $350k, I want retail price.
final_approved_text: Zillow does not factor in repairs or holding costs. We take it as is without any realtor fees. What is your bottom dollar to let it go?
notes: Counters retail Zillow anchor with as is and zero realtor fees.

seller_inbound: Are you just going to lowball me like everyone else?
final_approved_text: No lowballs and no games. We run our numbers off real comps and pay all closing costs. What number makes sense for you?
notes: Defuses lowball skepticism with real comps and covered closing costs.

seller_inbound: The roof is leaking and the AC is dead, is that an issue?
final_approved_text: Not an issue at all. We take on major repairs like roofs and AC units all the time. How is the rest of the house holding up inside?
notes: Reassures on heavy repairs and probes interior condition without pushing price.

seller_inbound: The house is full of old furniture and 30 years of clutter, do I have to clean it out?
final_approved_text: You do not have to touch a thing. Take whatever personal items you want and leave the rest, we handle the full cleanout.
notes: Removes cleanout burden completely without pushing for price.

seller_inbound: The city has daily code violations and fines piling up on the property.
final_approved_text: We do not pay fines, but we can call the county to request a reduction or removal of them. We have had success with that occasionally. How much were you hoping to get for the house?
notes: Honest policy that buyer requests reduction or removal from county.

seller_inbound: Who is 407flips and are you licensed realtors?
final_approved_text: We are local direct buyers here in Central Florida, not realtors. No commissions, no fees, and no showings. Just seeing if you want to sell {Address}.
notes: Establishes 407flips as direct buyer with zero commissions or showings.

seller_inbound: Are you wholesalers who are going to tie up my house and assign the contract?
final_approved_text: Sometimes, wholesale is an exit strategy. We can do the flip ourselves or buy and hold depends on the numbers. How much were you hoping to get?
notes: Transparent operator response confirming multiple exit strategies.

seller_inbound: How fast can you close?
final_approved_text: 7 days is the fastest. Less time is bigger risk on our end with less time to inspect, and a longer close is less risk for us. How soon were you looking to do something?
notes: Explains 7 days fastest and ties speed directly to inspection risk.

seller_inbound: I need to stay in the home for 30 days after closing until I find another place.
final_approved_text: We are not in the business of kicking people on the street. Ill mention it to John and he will go over options we can offer. If we can help with that, what would you be looking to walk away with?
notes: Empathetic post occupancy reassurance pivoting to walkaway price.

seller_inbound: It has cast iron pipes that are broken under the slab, does that scare you off?
final_approved_text: Not at all. We repipe homes on our projects frequently. How are the roof and AC holding up?
notes: Comfortable with cast iron replumbing without badgering on price.

seller_inbound: There is active termite damage and wood rot throughout the porch and eaves.
final_approved_text: We deal with wood rot and termite damage on most of our projects. Has an inspector looked at the structure?
notes: Validates termite and rot damage experience without badgering on price.

seller_inbound: The house was damaged in the last hurricane and has mold inside.
final_approved_text: We handle storm damage and remediation. We take it exactly as it sits.
notes: Takes storm and mold properties in current state without pushing for price.

seller_inbound: The pool is green and the pump equipment is completely broken.
final_approved_text: Pool repairs are standard for our renovations. How is the rest of the house holding up inside?
notes: Disarms pool repair concerns and probes interior condition.

seller_inbound: I need at least $250k cash in my pocket or I will just keep it.
final_approved_text: Got it. If the condition lines up with that number we can make it work. How are the roof and AC holding up?
notes: Validates price anchor conditionally and probes roof AC age.

seller_inbound: Can you pay my closing costs and fees?
final_approved_text: Yes, we cover all standard closing costs so you walk away with the agreed price. What number do you need?
notes: Confirms buyer covers closing costs.

seller_inbound: A realtor told me they can list it for $400k.
final_approved_text: With a realtor you pay 6 percent commission, closing fees, and buyers ask for repair credits. We buy direct with zero fees. What is your bottom dollar cash price?
notes: Contrasts realtor listing deductions with net cash offer.

seller_inbound: I will sell it for $150k if you can close by next Friday.
final_approved_text: That price works. Ill give this to John and he will call you with the offer so we can get the paperwork started. Thank you.
notes: Fast gold deal acceptance transitioning to John call.

seller_inbound: Where is your office located and how long have you been in business?
final_approved_text: We are based right here in Orlando and work across Central Florida and Pinellas. We do projects all year round. How is the condition of {Address}?
notes: Confirms local Orlando and Central Florida presence.

seller_inbound: Can you provide proof of funds or references from past sellers?
final_approved_text: John does our underwriting and can provide proof of funds with the purchase agreement.
notes: Confirms John does underwriting and provides proof of funds without pushing price.

seller_inbound: Do I have to let dozens of people walk through my house for open houses?
final_approved_text: No open houses and no strangers walking through. Just John doing a quick walkthrough to verify condition. Does that work for you?
notes: Eliminates open house fear with single buyer walkthrough.

seller_inbound: What kind of contract do you use, is it standard Florida paperwork?
final_approved_text: Yes, we use a standard Florida purchase agreement with clean terms and zero junk fees. What timeline works best for you to close?
notes: Standard Florida purchase contract reassurance.

seller_inbound: Do you require an appraisal or bank financing approval?
final_approved_text: No bank financing and no appraisals. We use our own funds so there are no lender delays. When were you looking to do something?
notes: Confirms zero bank or appraisal contingencies.

seller_inbound: The bank set an auction date for next month, can you close in time?
final_approved_text: Yes, we can close before the auction date and pay off the mortgage balance so it protects your equity. What is the payoff amount?
notes: Pivots pre foreclosure urgency to mortgage payoff balance.

seller_inbound: My sibling and I inherited this from our parents, probate is not finished yet.
final_approved_text: Sorry for your loss. We work with probate attorneys regularly and can buy once the court grants authority. Has an attorney been assigned yet?
notes: Navigates probate estate process respectfully.

seller_inbound: The building department red tagged the property as unsafe.
final_approved_text: We take on red tagged and condemned properties. We pull our own permits to fix the violations.
notes: Handles red tagged condemned properties without pushing for price.

seller_inbound: There are back property taxes owed from the last three years.
final_approved_text: Back taxes are paid right out of proceeds at closing so you do not come out of pocket. What are you looking to walk away with?
notes: Explains tax payoff at closing without out of pocket expense.

seller_inbound: What idea do you have for my house?
final_approved_text: Im with 407flips doing projects around town. We could take it as is if you want to sell. How is the condition of the place?
notes: Brooke competent intro answering what idea.

seller_inbound: Who is this and why are you texting me?
final_approved_text: My name is Brooke with 407flips. We do projects in the area and wanted to see if you had any thoughts on letting {Address} go.
notes: Brooke direct intro answering who is this.

seller_inbound: Sounds good, what is the next step?
final_approved_text: Got it. Ill give this to John and he will call you with the offer. Thank you.
notes: Clean direct closing handoff to John call with offer.

seller_inbound: Do you put down an earnest money deposit with your contract?
final_approved_text: Yes, we put up earnest money. John will go over the deposit when he makes the offer.
notes: Confirms earnest money deposit and deferral to John offer.

seller_inbound: How much earnest money deposit do you put up in escrow?
final_approved_text: It varies, John will go over it with you.
notes: Does not quote a number, explains it varies and defers to John.

seller_inbound: There is an IRS tax lien and an old contractor lien on the title.
final_approved_text: After we pay off your liens, what were you hoping to walk away with?
notes: Phrased so seller feels relief from liens. Paid at closing from purchase price by title.

seller_inbound: There are non paying tenants in the house and they refuse to leave.
final_approved_text: We take properties with problem tenants and handle the eviction process ourselves after closing.
notes: Takes occupied properties with non paying tenants without asking for price.

seller_inbound: Insurance dropped our policy because the roof is 20 years old and uninsurable.
final_approved_text: We buy without insurance requirements and handle the roof ourselves. How is the rest of the property holding up inside?
notes: Reassures on uninsurable roofs and dropped policies.

seller_inbound: The septic tank failed and the drain field needs to be completely replaced.
final_approved_text: Septic replacements are common on our projects. How are the roof and AC holding up?
notes: Normalizes septic and drain field failures and checks roof AC.

seller_inbound: It still has an old Federal Pacific electrical panel and cloth wiring.
final_approved_text: We rewire and upgrade electrical panels on our projects regularly. Has any work been updated recently?
notes: Normalizes vintage wiring and panels without pushing for price.

seller_inbound: There is a solar panel loan on the roof that I still owe money on.
final_approved_text: John does our underwriting and will look at whether the solar loan can be paid off or transferred.
notes: Uses underwriting reference for solar loan payoff or transfer.

seller_inbound: My brother and I both own the house but we disagree on what to do with it.
final_approved_text: We see that all the time. John will go over the numbers and options so both of you can decide if it works.
notes: De-escalates family disagreement and positions John as neutral numbers resource.

seller_inbound: The HOA has thousands of dollars in past due dues and violation fines.
final_approved_text: After we clear the HOA dues and liens at closing, what were you hoping to walk away with?
notes: Phrased so seller feels relief from HOA liens. Paid at closing from purchase price by title.

seller_inbound: If John makes an offer how long do I have to decide?
final_approved_text: Take your time to look it over. There is zero pressure and no obligation.
notes: Zero pressure reassurance when seller asks how long to decide.

seller_inbound: Do I need to hire an attorney to review the agreement?
final_approved_text: You are always welcome to have an attorney review it. Everything closes through a licensed Florida title company.
notes: Welcomes attorney review and confirms licensed title company closing.

seller_inbound: I want $600k, that is my price take it or leave it.
final_approved_text: So are you willing to sell the house as is for cash, or do you just want more than the house is really worth?
notes: Reality check for ridiculous highball asking price.

seller_inbound: Good luck finding anything cheaper, you guys are a joke.
final_approved_text: When you come back to reality and want a real cash offer let me know and ill make you a real one.
notes: Direct response to smart or rude seller when they refuse reality.

seller_inbound: I am not taking a discount, I want full retail value.
final_approved_text: If you want full retail, you should invest the cash and time to update it and list with a realtor on the MLS. We are in business to make money, not go broke.
notes: Redirects full retail seller to MLS and realtor with direct business reality.

seller_inbound: We have had higher offers.
final_approved_text: Why didn't you take it? A lot of buyers offer high to lock you up and then try to drop the price during inspection. If they back out let us know.
notes: Direct challenge on higher offers exposing inspection price drop games.

seller_inbound: What title company do you use, can we use my title company?
final_approved_text: We use our title company since we cover the closing costs and they move fast. Any further questions on title go through our underwriter John.
notes: Firm policy using internal title company and deferring questions to John.

seller_inbound: I was thinking around $285k for it.
final_approved_text: That could work if the place is completely updated. Does the roof, ac or plumbing need any work?
notes: Counter to asking price near Zestimate by qualifying whether roof, ac, or plumbing need work.
